title: Madad hussain ki
body:
madad hussain ki karne habeeb aaye hai
qadam qadam pe wafa ke naqoosh paaye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
badal raha hai zamana ka jasba e nusrat
zaeef hoke jawani ko saath laaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sin ye saal ye azme wafa mubarak ho
galay lagaane tumhe khud imam aaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab e hussain ki jumbish may hai nigaah sab kuch
payaam sun ke shahadat ka muskuraye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhe nabi ki nawasi salaam karti hai
habeeb martaba dekho to kaise paaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ho habeeb ke muslim zohair ho ke hilaal
qasam hai un ke kaleje pe teer khaaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ho rasool nabi ya payambarane salaf
hussain ki tarha as'haab kisne paaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaza bhi fazl shahadat ke waqt kehti hai
habeeb dekho sarhane hussain aaye hai
madad hussain ki karne...
author: Fazl Lakhnavi
